prompt: Create ONE individual complete-character 2D fighting-game sprite, polished cel shading with crisp dark contours, coherent with Digital Circus Encore. Keep all hat/bow tips, every hand, ornament, cane and the entire base/feet inside CLEAR TRANSPARENT MARGINS on ALL FOUR SIDES. True transparent RGBA. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, aura, external glow, particles, text, logo, watermark, inset or duplicate. One original static game adaptation; do not copy the product scene or its squat toy proportions. Reference 1 is the APPROVED SELECTION SEED: strictly preserve its identity, proportions, colors, exact anatomy and polished 2D style. Reference 2 supplies the official product details only. Make a genuinely different pose, never a mirrored or cropped copy of selection. DESIGN LOCK: ONE entire Bowling Pin Ragatha: familiar pale cloth Ragatha head with RED YARN HAIR, large BLUE BOW, one BLUE BUTTON EYE and the other normal eye with mauve eyelids, small triangular nose and friendly stitched-doll smile. Her ONLY BODY is a complete WHITE/VERY PALE GRAY BOWLING PIN with white pointed collar and rectangular PERIWINKLE PATCHES. The body narrows into a neck beneath the head and broadens into one continuous rounded pin base. ABSOLUTELY NO ARMS, HANDS, LEGS, FEET, normal dress skirt or added appendages. Preserve exactly this head-and-pin anatomy. The blue bowling ball and the other colored face-pins in the official photograph are separate props and must NOT appear. POSE: DEFEAT facing screen RIGHT: whole intact bowling-pin Ragatha lies low on its side in a clear diagonal exhausted pose, head on the screen-right end and complete rounded base on screen-left. Face remains recognizable, eyes tired. No broken pieces, limbs, ground, shadow or extra pin.

observations: Defeat lays the intact continuous pin on its side; no limbs, broken pieces, duplicate pin, floor or shadow appear.
